disposition_reason: Cadmium, lead, arsenic and mercury were measured by ICP-MS in three wild Agaricus mushroom species collected in Çanakkale, Turkey.

study.design: antioxidant and elemental impurity analysis of three wild Agaricus species, single collections
study.method: microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion (Ethos Easy); Cd, Pb, As, Hg by ICP-MS per USP <232>/<233>
study.lod_text: LOD Cd 0.01, Pb 0.03, As 0.01, Hg 0.03 µg/kg (calibration standards; Table 4, p. 6)
study.qa: triplicate analyses; calibration R2 ≥ 0.9997; no CRM or recovery reported
